topic: Release notes needed for analytics update
summary_markdown: Analytics v2023.9.1 was released, primarily involving changes to the Brazilian project's campaign area and inventory data. Discussion centered on whether release notes were required for this update. While some suggested clients already knew about the data changes, [me] stated that because it is a Release Candidate (RC), documentation is necessary. Another participant proposed writing the release notes after fixing an important data issue scheduled for Monday and Tuesday.
decisions: Release notes are needed for the Analytics v2023.9.1 RC.
action_items: Write release notes after completing critical data fixes on Monday/Tuesday.
